### 4.44  Misc


> **📇 Quick Reference Card**
> 
> **Purpose:** *The Transaction Recycler provides the ability to retry failed financial transactions again at regular intervals. This is a generic retry mechanism which can be consumed by any Temenos Transact application. The Transaction Recycler is available for Arrangement Architecture (AA) and Interest and Charg...*
> 
> **Applications:** `AA.PARAMETER`, `MS.PARAMETER`, `RC.CONTRACT.PRIORITY`
> 
> **Key Fields:** *Aa Product*, *Aa Product Group*, *Attribute Type*, *Attribute Value*, *Create Retry Trigger*, *Custom Priority Rank*, *Date Convention*, *Def Prev Settle* ... +33 more
> 
> **Sections:** 📖 Introduction


#### 📖 Introduction

Related topics:

- Temenos Transact Services

The Transaction Recycler provides the ability to retry failed financial transactions again at regular intervals. This is a generic retry mechanism which can be consumed by any Temenos Transact application. The Transaction Recycler is available for Arrangement Architecture (AA) and Interest and Charged (IC) modules (R13 release and above). Read Transaction Cycler section under Settlement Property Class for more information related to Arrangement Architecture.

The Transaction Recycler service handles the retry of failed transactions. This service will run as a COB job at a specific stage during both End of Day (EOD) and online phases. This job will retry the transactions on scheduled dates until the transaction is settled or number of retry attempts allowed have been exhausted or retry end date is reached.

During each retry, the Transaction Recycler will take the amount available in the settlement account for settling the transaction amount in full or partial, based on the Transaction Recycler retry configuration. The RC can retry the settlement based on pre-defined priority order as defined by the bank. In case of an AA loan repayment, the RC.CONTRACT.PRIORITY application allows the user to define sorting priority criteria based on custom values - the bill type or the aging status of bill.

The transactions handed over to Recycler (RC), if settled outside the RC framework are not excluded from further processing by RC and is marked with a specific status.

The following chart shows the transaction recycler process:

The Transaction Recycler acts as a framework and the processing required for retrying an AA payment or IC charges is built as a plug-in. In the above flow chart, the core plug-ins are generally represented as the payment processor, and the RC processes further, when there is an AA payment or an IC payment pending. The Transaction Recycler recognises that two different types of payments should be processed and the respective payment processor invoked is parameterised. This design enables the addition of new activity types (including any client-specific local activities) to be retried while using the same Transaction Recycler framework to orchestrate the recycling.


##### Product Configuration

The following chart shows the Transaction Recycler module components:

| Core Routine Fields | Description | Routine Name |
|---|---|---|
| Pre processor | Used to define whether a message specific core routine needs to be called to pre-process a message. | RC.PREP.RC.TYPE – For example, RC.PREP.IC.CHARGE |
| Prioritise | Used to define the message-specific core routine called by the Transaction Recycler to perform transaction grouping and sorting. | RC.PRTY.RC.TYPE – For example, RC.PRTY.IC.CHARGE |
| Processor | Used to define the message-specific core routine called by the Transaction Recycler to process the Transaction Recycler transaction, or transactions if they are grouped. | RC.PROC.RC.TYPE – For example, RC.PROCE.IC.CHARGE |
| Post process | Defines the message-specific API routine called by the Transaction Recycler to perform processing after the transaction has been completed. | RC.POST.RC.TYPE – For example, RC.POST.IC.CHARGE |

The RC.PRIORITY application is a highest level prioritisation parameter that allows to setup priority of transactions at the company level by EB.SYSTEM.ID or AA.PRODUCT.GROUP . This application is used in conjunction with RC.PRODUCT.PRIORITY and RC.CONTRACT.PRIORITY to create the rules regarding which type of transaction takes priority when there is more than one outstanding transaction against a settlement account. It ranks by EB.SYSTEM.ID , by AA.PRODUCT.GROUP or by a custom RC.PRODUCT.PRIORITY record and the ID to this application can be either a master or a lead company.

In the RC.PRIORITY application, the order of priorities are defined in the descending order (for example, the first definition has the highest priority and so on).

- In the above screenshot, the system is set up to consider the transactions in the following order, if multiple retry requests are posted against the same account:First: Products defined in the RC.PRODUCT.PRIORITY application in the PRIORITY+ONE record (direct debits sent by TPH with transaction code 125).

- Second: Products defined in the RC.PRODUCT.PRIORITY application in the MORTAGES record (MORTGAGE AA Product and then MORTGAGE.CASHBACK AA Product).

- Third: Products defined in the RC.PRODUCT.PRIORITY application in the PRIORITY +TPH record (direct debits sent by TPH with transaction code 213).

- Fourth: Request posted by the PAYMENT.ORDER application, irrespective of the request type.

When using as a priority, either a System ID (an EB.SYSTEM.ID record), the system does not require a correspondent RC.PRODUCT.PRIORITY record. If the RC.PRODUCT.PRIORITY record is not defined, it will process all retry transaction requests posted by the application in a default order, considering the oldest one received by the recycler first.

> **⚠️ Note:** The system allows only one option for each priority to be entered. This can either be an EB.SYSTEM.ID, an AA.PRODUCT.GROUP or a Product Priority (custom RC.PRODUCT.PRIORITY ID ).

Def Prev Settle is a filtering rule that means if, out of a list of ‘n’ pending transactions, one of transactions could not be settled (during retry), then all subsequent pending transactions in that list will be abandoned. It could be set to either Yes or No or left blank. If selected, it is applicable for EB.SYSTEM.ID , AA.PRODUCT.GROUP or Product Priority. This field is mutually exclusive with Prev Settle field.

The Prev Settle field can be set as Yes or No. If set to Yes, during retry of ‘n’ transactions, all transactions must be settled. Even if one of the transactions fail for some reason, then none of the remaining transactions will be considered for settlement.

The RC.CONTRACT.PRIORITY application is used in conjunction with RC.PRIORITY and RC.PRODUCT.PRIORITY to create the rules regarding the type of transaction that takes priority when there is more than one outstanding transaction against a settlement account. The RC.CONTRACT.PRIORITY is used to set the ranks at transaction level for the same type of retry request. It is used to set priority by value date, transaction amount or by a custom setting, for example by bills overdue status sent to Recycler by Arrangement Architecture (AA).

For example, if there are several transactions for the same product type against the settlement account, then the transactions have to be prioritised.

- The oldest transactions are processed first.
- If there are more than one transaction due for the same date and type, then prioritise by the largest amount first.

The RC.CONTRACT.PRIORITY application allows the user to define sorting priority criteria based on custom values. For example, based on the bills’ status issued by AA in case of loans repayments. To perform this, set:

- Due Type - Sort By Priority Attribute
- Due Rule - Custom

The Priority Rank Type field in RC.CONTRACT.PRIORITY accepts the following three options:

- Aging Status - Enables prioritisation based on the aging status of bills generated for each arrangement.
- Bill Type - Enables prioritisation of bill ( RC.DETAIL ) records based on the bill type of the arrangements.
- Blank – The value is used if the prioritization is by Aging Status of the bills.

It is not possible to set the prioritization by both Aging Status /Blank and Bill Type in the same record.

The multi-valued Custom Priority Rank field must contain custom values in the order which they must be sorted. Based on the Custom Priority Rank the Custom Priority Rank field must contain valid EB.LOOKUP record values from AA.OVERDUE.STATUS or from AA.BILL.TYPE .

In the example below, the custom values represent the overdue bill’s status based on aging / bill type as they are sent by AA to Recycler, to process the retry requests.

> **⚠️ Note:** It is not possible to set the prioritization by both Aging Status / Blank and Bill Type in the same record.

The overdue status is shown in the RC.DETAIL record after the request is settled.

> **⚠️ Note:** The AA Payment Rules setup must be in sync with the setup done in the Recycler priority setup tables. For example, if the oldest bill setup is done in AA Payment Rules, the same setup must be done in the recycler.

For example, if the Payment Rules are setup to consider the oldest bill first for an AA Product, and for the same AA Product, the contract priority rule is setup to consider the largest amount first (different setup than in Payment Rules), the system works as follows:

- If two bills are issued for the same contract on the same date, the system settles the bills by date (oldest one first) ignoring the ‘By amount’ setup in the recycler.
- If two bills are issued for the same contract on different dates, the system settles the bills considering the ‘By amount’ setup in the recycler.
- If two bills are issued for different contracts on different dates, the system settles the bills considering the ‘By amount’ setup in the recycler.
- If two bills are issued for different contracts on the same date, the system settles the bills by date (oldest one first) ignoring the ‘By amount’ setup in the recycler.

The user can define product priorities based on contract custom criteria using the RC.PRODUCT.PRIORITY application. If the user wants to define such priority, the Rank Based Priority field must be defined with the RC.CONTRACT.PRIORITY custom name. If this is set, the order defined in RC.CONTRACT.PRIORITY is applied to all products setup in RC.PRODUCT.PRIORITY . For example, it is possible to define custom priority criteria based on bills overdue status and based on product type. The bills overdue status should be setup first in the RC.CONTRACT.PRIORITY application as a custom record (read the RC.CONTRACT.PRIORITY for more details).

In order to sort the retry request based on the setup in RC.CONTRACT.PRIORITY and the one in the product order defined in RC.PRODUCT.PRIORITY , Priority Execution field must be defined. The values in this field are ’Rank Then Product’ and ’Product Then Rank’.

If the value ’Rank Then Product’ is selected, if more than one retry request is posted against the same account, the system orders requests based on the rank (status) defined in RC.CONTRACT.PRIORITY first and then by the product as defined in RC.CONTRACT.PRIORITY . If the value ’Product Then Rank’ is selected, the system orders the requests by product first and then by their rank from the RC.CONTRACT.PRIORITY application.

The following screenshot shows the RC.PRODUCT.PRIORITY is created with the value ’Rank Then Product’.

The RC.CONTRACT.PRIORITY custom record ‘MORTGAGELOANS’ has the setup as shown in the below screenshot.

The RC.PRODUCT.PRIORITY record is setup to order the requests according to the rank (status) first and then according to the product order (MORTGAGE.LOANS.USD and then MORTGAGE.LOANS.1Y), if more than one request has the same rank (status).

In case the RC.PRODUCT.PRIORITY record has a custom ID and if the Priority Execution field is defined with the value ’Rank Then Product’, the Aa Product Group field will become multivalued, allowing the definition of priorities based on products which are part of different AA PRODUCT GROUPS in the same record.

The input of Aa Product Group field is mandatory in case any Aa Product are defined. The Aa Product definition is not mandatory if the Aa Product Group is entered. If only the Aa Product Group is defined, the system considers all the retry requests posted by any product type within the product group and orders them by date (the oldest one is considered first). It is not possible to define a duplicate combination of Aa Product Group and Aa Product of the same type in the same record.

The online recycler checks for the following:

- New triggers on the accounts with active retry requests.
- Retry request for which the cut off time has passed.

The RC.PARAMETER application controls the retry trigger and the Create Retry Trigger field can have one of the following options:

- Any Credit – The system creates a retry trigger ( RC.RETRY.TRIGGER table application) for any credit posted on the account.
- Credit Balance – The system creates a retry trigger only if the new credit makes the account balance positive.

In the OVERRIDE record, ACCT.UNAUTH.OD, the Susp Appln field and Fwd Acct Mode should to be configured, as shown in the example below:

| Scenario 1 Schedule Initiation on Holiday parameter is configured | Scenario 2 Schedule Initiation on Holiday parameter is not configured |
|---|---|
| Transaction Recycler retries the transaction to settle the bill. System checks the value date when the settlement account received the funds. As it is backdated, RC settles the bill with value date on Saturday. Penalty interest accrued for Saturday and Sunday is reversed, and only one day of penalty interest is applied to the contract. Bill is settled & Contract status = Current, as of Saturday. | Transaction Recycler retries the transaction to settle the bill. System checks the value date when the settlement account received the funds. As it is backdated, RC settles the bill with the value date on Saturday. Age Overdue activity is reversed and not replayed. Total amount for which the customer is charged = Instalment amount + One day’s penalty. Due to the reversal of the ageing activities, the penalty interest is posted to UNC/remainder activity. |


##### Business Events

When the Emit Business Event field in MS.PARAMETER is set as ‘Yes’, the business events representing the state change are emitted.

The following business events are emitted for Transaction Recycler.

| Business Event | Description |
|---|---|
| settlementService.transactionRetry.currentRetry | Event to be emitted when the transaction retry is moved to current status |
| settlementService.transactionRetry.fundRecovered | Event to be emitted for a transaction retry when the funds are recovered successfully |
| settlementService.transactionRetry.fundReserved | Event to be emitted for a transaction retry when the funds are reserved successfully |
| settlementService.transactionRetry.manuallyApproved | Event to be emitted when a transaction is manually approved |
| settlementService.transactionRetry.retryCancelled | Event to be emitted when the transaction retry is cancelled |
| settlementService.transactionRetry.retryCompleted | Event to be emitted when the transaction retry is completed |
| settlementService.transactionRetry.retryCreated | Event to be emitted when the transaction retry is created |


> **Related Applications:** `AA.PARAMETER`, `MS.PARAMETER`, `RC.CONTRACT.PRIORITY`

## Appendix B: Consolidated Field Reference


This appendix consolidates all field description tables from across the documentation, grouped by sub-module. This provides a single reference for all field definitions.


### Corporate_Lending - CONLIB (CONLIB)


**Guarantee**

| Line Attributes | Description |
|---|---|
| CCY | Indicates the Product Line deals with the amount |
| Replay | Indicates the Product Line that supports reverse and replay |

**Guarantee**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Amount | Specifies the amount of the guarantee contract. It cannot be zero or negative |
| Expiry Date | Specifies the validity or expiry date of the Guarantee contract. Indicates that the banks can define a relative date with respect to the arrangement date of the contract as the expiry date of the contract (For example, R_ARRANGEMENT+6M ). |
| Update.Commit.Limit | Indicates that the limit is attached to a guarantee product to control the exposure of the bank to a particular customer. System defaults this attribute to ‘YES’ if the guarantee is linked to a limit |
| Expire To Maturity Period | Defines the claim period (grace period beyond the validity period of the Guarantee to make a demand for the default from the bank) for the Guarantee or SBLC contract. It can be either in days, weeks, months or years. |
| Term | Defines the period until when the Guarantee or SBLC arrangement remains valid and negotiable. It can be either in days (D), weeks (W), months (M), or years (Y). |

**Guarantee**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Swift | It is an optional field, which is used to capture the terms and conditions details of the guarantee. It is an optional text field which is limited to 150 lines and each line can hold a maximum of 65 characters. |
| Applicable Rules | It is a mandatory field, which is used to set the pre-defined codes. It holds the details of the governing law, under which capacity of the Guarantee or SBLC undertaking is issued. Valid predefined codes are: ISPR NONE OTHR UCPR URDG |
| Applicable Rules Text | It is a text field that captures the narrative clauses when the predefined code is OTHR. |

**Misc**

| S.No. | Product Name | Product Attributes |
|---|---|---|
| 1. | Contingent Liabilities | Financial Guarantee Financial SBLC Performance Guarantee Performance SBLC |


### Corporate_Lending - FL (FL)


**Hybrid Pooling**

| Account Type | Company Name | System Date |
|---|---|---|
| CT account (100001) | Temenos core banking Norway company | 25/10/2017 |
| TR account (100002) | Temenos core banking Norway Sweden | 23/10/2017 |
| TR account (100003) | Temenos Core Banking Norway Finland | 24/10/2017 |

**Cashflow Netting**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Cashflow Netting | Indicates whether Cashflow Netting is applicable or not, this feature helps to consolidate multiple cash inflows and outflows thereby reducing the volume of individual transactions. |
| Defaults to the value specified in the Sub Arrangement Conditions at the facility level for drawing products. |  |
| Net Settlement Activity | Specifies the activity that performs Cashflow Netting . Accepts a valid facility activity related to payment rules or payment priority properties. This is applicable only when the cash flow is enabled. |
| The Net Settlement Activity is configured at the drawing product level. |  |

**Defining Default SSI**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Def Ccy | Specifies the currency of the arrangement for which the settlement instruction applies. It has to be a valid currency from the CURRENCY table. It is multi-value field and input is optional. |
| Def Customer | Specifies the customer of the arrangement for which the settlement instruction applies. It must be either a valid customer number or customer mnemonic of a customer on the CUSTOMER table. It is multi-value field and input is optional. |
| Def Account | This is the default settlement account field. This field is part of the multi-value set for defining the default settlement instructions. This can be specified for each settlement customer and currency wise. This account is used if there is no pay-in or pay-out account/beneficiary is specified in the settlement instructions. |
| Def Beneficiary | Specifies the default beneficiary id for the customer and currency specified. This beneficiary is used for incoming and outgoing transactions if pay-in or pay-out account/beneficiary details are not given. It has to be a valid record from the BENEFICIARY table. Input to this field is mandatory , when the Default Po Product field is not blank. |

**Facility Charges**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Action | TRANSFER.AMORT |
| Accrue Amort | Amort Defer |
| Accrue Period | MATURITY or EXPIRY |

**Internal Portfolio Allocation in Facility**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Ifrs Classification | Defines the classification of contract based on IFRS standard. It must be a valid record from IAS.CLASSIFICATION . Once created, it cannot be modified. |
| Ifrs Subtype | Defines the sub-type for the corresponding classification defined in Ifrs Classification . It cannot be amended at arrangement-level. |
| Market Key | Defines the market rate to calculate the NPV based on future cash flow information. It can either be fixed rate or periodic variable rate This field is mandatory if Ifrs Classification holds any value. |
| Market Margin | Defines the NPV based on the future cash flow information. |
| Margin Operand | Defines the operation performed when calculating the rate using the market margin value. Allowed values are ADD and SUB. |
| Branch | Defines the company to which the business unit belongs. |
| Department | Defines the internal department. |
| Portfolio Id | Defines the portfolio for which the IFRS classification is defined and reporting is performed. |

**Misc**

| Product Name | Product Attributes |
|---|---|
| Credit Line Facility | Credit Line Facility product with default term as 10 years and Revolving as Payment. |
| Corporate Facilities | Revolving Facility Term Facility |
| Digital Mortgage Facilities | Digital Mortgage Facility - The facility product can have drawings created under Mortgage group or Home Equity group. |

**Pricing Grid**

| Field Name | Description |
|---|---|
| Type | Allowed values are, Field – When the user choses the internal rating criterion, the value should be Field since the system checks for the value of the criterion, (that is, internal rating) in the Customer Rating field of CUSTOMER application. Balance – When the user chooses balance criterion, the value should be Balance, since the system checks for the respective balance type at the arrangement level. Property – When the user chooses interest criterion, the value in this field should be Property to check the relevant property for the values. |
| Data Source | The source of the data can be from any of the following, Arrangement Customer Collateral |
| Arrangement Level | When the Data Source field is set as Arrangement’, then this level should be specified. So that, the system retrieves the data value either from arrangement being processed or from its parent. |
| Arrangement source | When the Data Source field is set as Arrangement, the source should be specified, (the Property Class which the system should check in the arrangement). Allowed values are Interest or Account. |
| Field | Refers to the field in CUSTOMER , LIMIT and COLLATERAL applications or the Arrangement Source field where the data is located. |
| Balance | Refers to the balance that needs to be retrieved. |
| Data type | A system updated field indicating the IN2 type of the field. This allows the UX to understand what type of field needs to be displayed to the user. |
| Data Check File | Updates the application from which the system pre-fetches the actual value. For example, in case of internal rating criterion, the Customer Rating field in the CUSTOMER application must be a valid record from EB.RATING application. |
| Data Selection | If Data Check File is specified, the user can provide selection criteria in this field and the system filters the list of IDs that need to be present to the user. For example, in the case of internal rating criterion, the user specifies AGENCY.ID EQ INTERNAL condition. That is, the records with Agency ID field value as Internal alone is filtered from the EB.RATING table. |
| Catch all | If none of the criteria matches, then this is used as default condition. |
| Catch all value | Captures the value for the default condition. |

**Pricing Grid**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Type | Allowed values are: Fixed Rate – The corresponding rate is captured. Margin Type – The user can choose Margin type, Margin operand and Margin rate. Usage Percentage – The corresponding Usage percentage is captured which is applied on the reference rate to get the effective rate. |
| Data Type | System defaults this field value as IN2. |
| Value Type | Allowed values are Input and Defined. When set as, Input – The user can enter values manually at Arrangement level. Defined – The system fetches the values from the product condition level. |

**Pricing Grid**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Criteria ID | A multi-value field and the user can select the criterion as defined in AA.DATA.ELEMENTS, in the order of precedence. |
| Target ID | A multi-value field and the user can select the targets as defined in AA.TARGET.ELEMENTS in the order of precedence. |
| Default | The default target value is used if none of the criteria combinations are satisfied at runtime. This is a mandatory field for fixed rate targets and optional input for margin targets. |
| Criteria 1, 2...10 | Stores the grid values of the criterion selected by the user. For example, if the Criteria ID field is set as PROPERTY, then the value in this field can be PRINCIPALINT. |
| Target 1, 2…..10 | Stores the grid values of the target(s) selected by the user. For example, if the Target ID field is set as CUSTOMER.MARGIN, then the value in this field can be 1.5 (margin rate). |

**Splits Merge Rollover**

| Field Name | Description |
|---|---|
| Rollover Type | Defines the type of rollover is Split, Merge or Rollover. |
| XX | Captures the source arrangement ids that are to be merged or split. In case of standalone loan splits/merges, the source arrangement id ise auto populated. In case of loans under facility the source arrangement id will have to be entered. |
| XX - Source Arrangement Product | Displays the product of the source arrangement and is a system maintained field. |
| XX - Source Currency | Displays the currency of the source arrangement and is a system maintained field. |
| XX - Outstanding Principal | Displays the outstanding principal amount and is a system maintained field. |
| XX - Repay Amount | Defines the amount that the borrower is willing to repay on the split or merge date. It must not be greater than the outstanding amount. But this field is restricted for the source arrangements that are retained as a part of the rollover. |
| Source Rollover Amount | Indicates the net outstanding amount after the borrower repayment that is available for rollover, splits and merges. This is a system maintained field. |
| XX | Holds the target arrangement id and is a system maintained field. If NEW value is entered in this field, the system generates a new ID on its own. Alternatively, and users can define their own ID. Likewise, if the user wishes to continue with the original loan, then the loan ID of the original loan must be entered in this field. |
| XX - Target Arr Product | Defines the product of the new target arrangement. The user can change the product of the target arrangement and the same should be one among the allowed products defined at the parent level. Change of product is not allowed for the target arrangements, which are one of the source arrangements that are retained as part of the rollover. |
| XX - Target Currency | Displays the currency of the target arrangement and is defaulted based on the source arrangement currency. |
| XX - Target Rollover Amount | Displays the amount that is rolled over to the target arrangement. |
| XX - Commitment Increase | Defines any increase in commitment of the loan during the loan rollover. |
| XX - Total Target Amount | Displays the net amount for which the new target arrangement is created. This is a system maintained field. |
| XX -Target Repricing Period | Defines the repricing period for the target arrangements. This will be used to calculate the next interest rate repricing period and the next rollover date. It can be given as a period, not as a date. The valid suffixes are D/W/M/Y. |

**Misc**

| S.NO | Parameters | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Account | The Account property class is used by all the products which are account based. This property class primarily controls the description of the account. The ACCOUNT property allows the user to define and control balance treatment, posting restriction, linked account number (for memo accounts), currency market, date convention related setup for the account. Although the account names are account specific, generic titles can be defaulted from the product and can be replaced or given additional detail at the arrangement level. Each product defined and processed in AA can have a single ACCOUNT Property defined. |
| 2 | Activity Charges | The Activity Charges property class defines the charges that have to be applied when a particular activity is triggered on the arrangement. The charges so applied can be made due, capitalised or deferred. The user can enable auto settle the charges made due from unallocated credit balance by setting this to Yes. In accounts, charges are enabled for dormancy, settle payoff and ageing. This property class is also extensively used for all AA related modules, charges are set for various other activities. |
| 3 | Activity Restriction | The Activity Restriction property class is used to specify a restriction on a particular transaction. The restriction rules including the relevant periodic attributes and activities are defined in the product condition. These rules are then used to define activity based or property based restrictions. A rule if broken can be set to result in an override or error. A charge can be attached for this and can be set to be made due, capitalised or deferred. For the AR module, activity restriction is extensively used for restricting transactions by number, type, and so on. This is also extensively used in other modules to restrict the user from doing various user activity based on the life cycle status of contracts. |
| 4 | Balance Availability | The Balance Availability property class allows the user to control the following features pertaining to AR module: Notice amount and period, which needs to be given by a customer for withdrawing money from his account. Default Credit Check and Available Balance update related set up. Activity class or Activity specific credit check, and NSF related fees pertaining to it Tolerance Amount or Tolerance Currency - To indicate the grace amount, which is the allowed overdraft before the bank imposes NSF or OD fees. Overdraft Grace Period - To waive the NSF fee levied on the account, if the customer clears the debit balance within the stipulated grace period. |
| 5 | Dormancy | The Dormancy property class allows the user to control the parameterisation of inactive or dormant accounts and movement of the same into various buckets at the arrangement or product level. The same can be controlled based on period, and some exceptions or rules also can be added for evaluation and movement. The user can include or exclude certain activity or activity class for the evaluation. It is possible to, Configure different Dormancy status based on the period of inactivity Specify different charges and charging frequency for each Dormancy status Apply some exception rule filtering at an individual arrangement level (for example, account is in debit balance) and such rules can either be an API or a rule created using the Rules Engine Specify notices and notice frequency for each Dormancy status Specify Activities or Activity Classes or Activity Initiation Types which are qualified to keep an account active. Auto Reset can be enabled based on status or on Activity Type. |
| 6 | Facility | The Facility is a service component for financial products designed using arrangement architecture. The Facility property class controls the list of available services for an arrangement account. When an external activity (financial or non-financial) is triggered and the corresponding service group is mapped to an activity through Activity Mapping and EB.EVENTS . And the same came allowed or restricted or charged corresponding error message is raised to stop the activity. |
| 7 | Inheritance | The Inheritance property class is used for BN pool structure for inheriting the product conditions set at Parent level arrangement to the Child level arrangement accounts. The product conditions that are set for inheritance are attached to Property records with type as Inheritance Only. The properties to be inherited can be controlled both at source and target level. |
| 8 | Interest | The Interest property class is used for all interest definition and processing in AA. A product defined and processed in AA can have multiple interest properties defined (for example, principal interest, penalty interest, commission, etc. Interest rates can be defined as fixed , floating , periodic or linked rate (referring an INTEREST property from other arrangement), routine based calculation. Tiered interest can also be defined. Further it is possible to define a negative rate, minimum interest amount and waive the interest. Interest adjustment can be done in run time, and adjustment related detail or values can be captured in adjustment related fields. |
| 9 | Limit | The Limit property class primarily controls the use of LIMIT module by the product. We can set up single or shared limit. We can define the LIMIT.REFERENCE applicable for a specific product such that the system defaults the same in an arrangement. For a new limit, at the arrangement level, the LIMIT.SERIAL has to be given as NEW. The AR module can have self-contained secondary limit without having actual limit attached to it. Overdraft status or notice for AR module is handled inside the Limit Property class. Further Limits can be set to use the LIMIT module (AL and AD) or it can be managed only within the arrangement architecture framework. |
| 10 | Payment Schedule | The Payment Schedule property class is used by all products which have amounts billed (that is,made due) or capitalised or Pay. A Payment Schedule can be comprised of one or more payment definitions with conditions such as payment Type and Method, arrangement properties, dates and amounts. The AA.PAYMENT.TYPE application is used to define the standard payment types such as constant, linear, actual and fixed equal and so on, that can be used by a product. This payment type is then attached to each payment schedule definition. The start and end date can be specified, the user can specify the repayment of arrangement to commence after ‘n’ months from the arrangement date or ‘n’ months before the maturity or ‘n’ months after the change product or reset and rollover has happened. |
| 11 | Periodic Charges | The Periodic Charges property class acts as a container to group different charge properties and calculate a periodic charge amount. The Payment Schedule property class drives this property class. A periodic charge property can be attached in payment schedule and on schedule date periodic charge amount is calculated. At the arrangement level adjustment can be done by the user on whole periodic charge. |
| 12 | Statement | The Statement property class is used to define the legacy ACCT.STATEMENT feature at the AA level. Statements may be produced daily (every working day), every 1-9 weeks, twice a month (on the 15th and the last day of the month) or every 1-12 months on any day of the month. Up to nine statement cycles may be specified for each account, and each statement cycle is independent. In addition to this, special interim statements can be enabled. This property class also controls whether or not advices are to be produced when interest and charges are applied, and whether detailed interest statements (interest scale) should be produced. Within a statement cycle, it is possible to define multiple frequencies with a combination of weekly and monthly, such that statements are produced on the dates specified by both frequencies, but only contain details of entries since the last statement in that cycle. |

**Misc**

| S.NO | Parameters | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Account | The Account property class is used by all the products which are account based. This property class primarily controls the description of the account. The ACCOUNT property allows the user to define and control balance treatment, posting restriction, linked account number (for memo accounts), currency market, date convention related setup for the account. Although the account names are account specific, generic titles can be defaulted from the product and can be replaced or given additional detail at the arrangement level. Each product defined and processed in AA can have a single ACCOUNT Property defined. |
| 2 | Activity Charges | The Activity Charges property class defines the charges that have to be applied when a particular activity is triggered on the arrangement. The charges so applied can be made due, capitalised or deferred. The user can enable auto settle the charges made due from unallocated credit balance by setting this to Yes. In accounts, charges are enabled for dormancy, settle payoff and ageing. This property class is also extensively used for all AA related modules, charges are set for various other activities. |
| 3 | Activity Restriction | The Activity Restriction property class is used to specify a restriction on a particular transaction. The restriction rules including the relevant periodic attributes and activities are defined in the product condition. These rules are then used to define activity based or property based restrictions. A rule if broken can be set to result in an override or error. A charge can be attached for this and can be set to be made due, capitalised or deferred. For the AR module, activity restriction is extensively used for restricting transactions by number, type, and so on. This is also extensively used in other modules to restrict the user from doing various user activity based on the life cycle status of contracts. |
| 4 | Balance Availability | The Balance Availability property class allows the user to control the following features pertaining to AR module: Notice amount and period, which needs to be given by a customer for withdrawing money from his account. Default Credit Check and Available Balance update related set up. Activity class or Activity specific credit check, and NSF related fees pertaining to it Tolerance Amount or Tolerance Currency - To indicate the grace amount, which is the allowed overdraft before the bank imposes NSF or OD fees. Overdraft Grace Period - To waive the NSF fee levied on the account, if the customer clears the debit balance within the stipulated grace period. |
| 5 | Dormancy | The Dormancy property class allows the user to control the parameterisation of inactive or dormant accounts and movement of the same into various buckets at the arrangement or product level. The same can be controlled based on period, and some exceptions or rules also can be added for evaluation and movement. The user can include or exclude certain activity or activity class for the evaluation. It is possible to, Configure different Dormancy status based on the period of inactivity Specify different charges and charging frequency for each Dormancy status Apply some exception rule filtering at an individual arrangement level (for example, account is in debit balance) and such rules can either be an API or a rule created using the Rules Engine Specify notices and notice frequency for each Dormancy status Specify Activities or Activity Classes or Activity Initiation Types which are qualified to keep an account active. Auto Reset can be enabled based on status or on Activity Type. |
| 6 | Facility | The Facility is a service component for financial products designed using arrangement architecture. The Facility property class controls the list of available services for an arrangement account. When an external activity (financial or non-financial) is triggered and the corresponding service group is mapped to an activity through Activity Mapping and EB.EVENTS . And the same came allowed or restricted or charged corresponding error message is raised to stop the activity. |
| 7 | Inheritance | The Inheritance property class is used for BN pool structure for inheriting the product conditions set at Parent level arrangement to the Child level arrangement accounts. The product conditions that are set for inheritance are attached to Property records with type as Inheritance Only. The properties to be inherited can be controlled both at source and target level. |
| 8 | Interest | The Interest property class is used for all interest definition and processing in AA. A product defined and processed in AA can have multiple interest properties defined (for example, principal interest, penalty interest, commission, etc. Interest rates can be defined as fixed , floating , periodic or linked rate (referring an INTEREST property from other arrangement), routine based calculation. Tiered interest can also be defined. Further it is possible to define a negative rate, minimum interest amount and waive the interest. Interest adjustment can be done in run time, and adjustment related detail or values can be captured in adjustment related fields. |
| 9 | Limit | The Limit property class primarily controls the use of LIMIT module by the product. We can set up single or shared limit. We can define the LIMIT.REFERENCE applicable for a specific product such that the system defaults the same in an arrangement. For a new limit, at the arrangement level, the LIMIT.SERIAL has to be given as NEW. The AR module can have self-contained secondary limit without having actual limit attached to it. Overdraft status or notice for AR module is handled inside the Limit Property class. Further Limits can be set to use the LIMIT module (AL and AD) or it can be managed only within the arrangement architecture framework. |
| 10 | Payment Schedule | The Payment Schedule property class is used by all products which have amounts billed (that is,made due) or capitalised or Pay. A Payment Schedule can be comprised of one or more payment definitions with conditions such as payment Type and Method, arrangement properties, dates and amounts. The AA.PAYMENT.TYPE application is used to define the standard payment types such as constant, linear, actual and fixed equal and so on, that can be used by a product. This payment type is then attached to each payment schedule definition. The start and end date can be specified, the user can specify the repayment of arrangement to commence after ‘n’ months from the arrangement date or ‘n’ months before the maturity or ‘n’ months after the change product or reset and rollover has happened. |
| 11 | Periodic Charges | The Periodic Charges property class acts as a container to group different charge properties and calculate a periodic charge amount. The Payment Schedule property class drives this property class. A periodic charge property can be attached in payment schedule and on schedule date periodic charge amount is calculated. At the arrangement level adjustment can be done by the user on whole periodic charge. |
| 12 | Statement | The Statement property class is used to define the legacy ACCT.STATEMENT feature at the AA level. Statements may be produced daily (every working day), every 1-9 weeks, twice a month (on the 15th and the last day of the month) or every 1-12 months on any day of the month. Up to nine statement cycles may be specified for each account, and each statement cycle is independent. In addition to this, special interim statements can be enabled. This property class also controls whether or not advices are to be produced when interest and charges are applied, and whether detailed interest statements (interest scale) should be produced. Within a statement cycle, it is possible to define multiple frequencies with a combination of weekly and monthly, such that statements are produced on the dates specified by both frequencies, but only contain details of entries since the last statement in that cycle. |

**Capturing Trade Transaction**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Trade Id | Specifies the system’s unique reference generated for each Trade captured |
| Activity | Specifies the activity which is performed on a trade based on the trade life cycle |
| Alternate Id | Specifies the external system or market reference of a trade in case it originated from an external system. In Transact, it is created as an alternate key for a trade |
| Product | Specifies the trade product or type and based on this, the related fields are defaulted and maintained for a trade. It must be a valid record in LOAN.TRADE.PRODUCT.CATALOG |
| Governing Law | Helps mainly in querying the trade by jurisdiction. It is updated based on trade product selected |
| Type Of Trade | Updated based on trade product selected and could be either par or distressed |
| Transaction Type | Updated based on the activity. The available options are BUY, SELL and TRANSFER |
| Transfer Type | Specifies the type of the transfer for a trade. The available options are Internal Assignment Risk participation Sub participation |
| Counter Party | Specifies the trade counterparty ID. It is a mandatory field, and it must be a valid customer in Transact |
| Counter Party Role | Based on the transaction type, the system defaults the counterparty role upon the validation of the trade. For a buy and sell trade, the counterparties are seller and buyer respectively If the transfer type is trade, then both buyer and seller must be manually defined |
| Trade Currency | Specifies the currency of the trade. It is a mandatory field. The value must be one among the allowed currencies that are defined in the trade product |
| Trade Amount | Specifies the amount of the trade in the trade currency. It is a mandatory field |
| Trade Date | Specifies the date when the trade takes place. It can be the current bank date or back value, but cannot be a forward date. If left blank, the default value is current bank date |
| Booking Date | Maintains the system date on which the trade is captured into the system. It cannot be a forward or back-value date |
| Exp Settle Date | Specifies the date that is set as a standard for each and every trade product. It is configured according to the trade market standards. |
| Actual Settlement Date | Specifies the actual settlement date of the trade and it must be always on or after the Trade Date . Once Exp Settle Date is defined, system automatically defaults the same date to Actual Settlement Date . Users can modify the settlement date using Actual Settlement Date. It is possible to change the Actual Settlement Date to a date beyond or after Exp Settle Date but not beyond the current system date. |
| Participation Type | Specifies one of the following values: Fixed - Does not increase the participant's share on a pro-rata basis when there is an increase in Global commitment Variable – Increases the participant's share on a pro-rata basis when there is an increase in Global commitment. Input is allowed only when Transfer Type is Risk Participation. |
| Status | Specifies the status of a trade. The status available are: Awaiting Confirmation Confirmed Documents Completed Settled Cancelled The system defaults the status and the user cannot change the status manually |
| Notes | Specifies the free text field which records any additional notes or information for the trade. It is non-mandatory |
| Bus Day Centres | Specifies the holiday calendars which are used to determine whether the expected settlement date is a working date or not It is mandatory when settlement happens on a working day The system defaults the Bus Day Centres from the Loan Trade Product when trade currency is defined. The user is allowed to change it only once. Once authorized the Bus day centre cannot be changed |

**Capturing Trade Transaction**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Reference | Mention the arrangement ID of a particular deal, facility or drawing in the Reference field to indicate that, it is the loan being traded Instead, a user can mention any relevant reference id in the Reference field and later can create an arrangement and modify with the correct arrangement ID before settlement |
| Title | Indicates the title for the trade and is a mandatory field. It is either automatically defaulted based on the reference ID of the arrangement or user can input the title |
| Borrower’s ID | Specifies the borrower involved in the credit agreement. This can be either left blank or a valid customer ID can be given as an input to automatically default the borrower’s name during trade capture |
| Borrower’s Name | Specifies the borrower’s name When the borrower is a valid customer in transact, then the customer ID of the borrower can be defined in the Borrower’s ID field. The borrower’s name is automatically defaulted upon validation When the Borrower is not a valid customer in transact, Banks can manually key in the Borrower’s name and leave the Borrower’s ID blank |
| Start Date | Specifies the start date of the credit agreement or deal. In case of an existing arrangement, the Start Date is defaulted with Arrangement’s start date |
| Currency | Specifies the currency of the credit agreement or Deal. In case of an existing deal or facility or drawing, the Currency field is defaulted with Arrangement’s currency |
| Amount | Specifies the global amount of the credit agreement or Deal. In case of an existing deal or facility or drawing, the Amount field is defaulted from Arrangement’s term amount property class |
| Agent Bank | Specifies whether the Agent Bank is Own Bank or some other bank If owning bank’s role is Agent/Agent cum Participant, then the user should select Own Bank If owning bank is a participant such as a buyer or a seller, then the user should select Other. When Agent Bank is Other, Agent Bank’s ID and Name should be inputted before the Trade is confirmed |
| Agent Bank’s ID | Specifies the agent bank’s ID If the Agent bank’s ID is available in Transact, Banks can input the ID and Agent bank’s name will be automatically defaulted If Agent bank’s ID is not available, it can be left blank, and the name can be input manually |
| Agent Bank’s Name | Specifies the agent bank’s name for the credit agreement or deal |
| Additional Info | Specifies any additional information of the credit agreement or deal that the system needs to record in a trade |

**Capturing Trade Transaction**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| SSI Party | Specifies the party to the trade (Seller/buyer) based on the transaction type captured. Other third parties like broker can also be defined |
| SSI Ccy | Specifies the currency to which the settlement instruction refers to. Different currencies can be defined for one party |
| SSI Product | Specifies the payment order product or payment channel to which the settlement instruction refers to. It must be a valid payment order product |
| SSI Beneficiary | Specifies the account details of the settlement party. It must be a valid record in BENEFICIARY table |
| Agent Beneficiary | Specifies the beneficiary details of the agent bank |

| Agent PO Product | Specifies the payment order product or payment channel for the transfer of funds to the Agent. It must be a valid Payment Order Product |

If Nostro accounts are not specified, then the system will use the Nostro Account table to pick the Nostro account for the settlement |
| Own Bank Ccy | Specifies a valid currency for which the Nostro account attached |
| Own Bank PO Product | Defines the Pay in payment order product |

**Capturing Trade Transaction**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Consent Type | Specifies the type of consent, which is mandatory for the trade. It is a no-input field and is defaulted from Participant property class of the arrangement being traded. |
| Consent Party | Specifies the party or parties whose consent is mandatory for a share transfer. The options available in this field are, BORROWER AGENT It is a no-input field and defaulted from Participant property class. |
| Consent Given | Specifies the status of consent. The options available are Yes and No. |
| Consent Date | Specifies the date when the consent is provided. |

**Capturing Trade Transaction**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Price | Specifies the price applicable to the entire trade. The values can be entered from 0.01 to 999.99. For trade priced more than 100 is referred as Premium Trade and for a trade priced less than 100 is referred as discounted Trade. For Transfer type trade, it is automatically defaulted to 100. It cannot take a value greater than or less than 100. |
| Share Percent | Specifies the percentage of share a participating bank is selling from this share, or a new buyer is buying from the global amount. The system automatically updates this field only when Exp Settle Date is input. Bank A sells USD 3 Million out of total amount USD 10 Million eligible to sell. The share percent is updated as 30. Bank B is an Agent cum Participant and buys USD 3 Million from Bank A who is an existing participant. The total amount available for trading with Bank A is USD 10 Million. The share percent is updated as 30. Bank A is a new buyer who buys USD 2 Million in a syndication of USD 10 Million, the share percent is 20. |
| Settlement Option | Specifies the method of final settlement between the buyer and seller. The allowed options are: Net – Settlement happens after netting all amount that is payable to and receivable from the counter party. Gross – Settlement happens without netting the payable and receivable amount. Counterparty account is credited for the total payable amount and debited for the total receivable amounts. By default, the option is ‘Net’ |
| Allow Netback | Specifies whether to calculate the net back amount for the undrawn amount based on the Price field. |
| Allow BoCR | Specifies whether to calculate the benefit of Commitment Reduction if applicable. |
| Trade Ac | Specifies the Facility or the Drawings that is being traded. The system shows all the available arrangements under the Reference field in Credit Agreement Details tab is defined in Trade Ac . If a deal is linked in the Reference field, this field becomes a drop down displaying all the facilities under that deal. If a facility or drawing is linked in the Reference field, this field becomes a drop down displaying the linked facility or drawing. This becomes a read-only field once the user provides a value in Exp Settle Date and authorises the same. |
| Commitment | Specifies the amount being traded under a facility or drawing that is provided in the trade account. This is an associated field to Trade Ac and if user has selected any arrangement in Trade Ac , this field becomes mandatory. The system allows the user to give input without trade account as well. The sum of the Commitment of all the Trade Ac cannot be greater than the value in ‘Trade Amount’ provided in the LOAN.TRADE application. |
| New Buyer | Specifies whether the buying counterparty to the trade is a new Lender. The system updates this field and the user cannot check or uncheck this field manually. The system checks whether the ‘Buy-Counterparty’ is available in the provided Trade Ac . If the counterparty is already available, it means that the buyer is an existing participant. If the counterparty is not available in the Trade Ac , it means that the buyer is a new buyer and system automatically checks the New Buyer field. If New Buyer is selected and the trade is a ‘Buy’ trade, then the values of Drawn and Undrawn is not automatically defaulted and must be manually entered by the user. |
| Issue Pricing | This field helps to inform the bank user when a pricing letter needs to be issued or when it needs to be re-issued due to changes in trade balances or settlement amount. If this field is checked, the system does not allow the user to settle the trade. It is a no-input field when Trade type is Transfer. Once the trade is executed and ready for settlement, the responsible party (seller or buyer) must issue the pricing letter, which contains the settlement amount and all the details of the underlying loans being traded. When there is any change in the settlement amount, the pricing letter is re-issued. If this field is checked by the system, it indicates that the pricing letter is yet to be issued or the pricing letter is to be re-issued due to the changes in the settlement amount. The user can proceed to settle the trade by one of the following options: Issue or re-issue the pricing letter using ISSUE.PRICING-TRADE activity Disable the Issue Pricing field to override and proceed for settlement |
| Loan Ac | Specifies the facility or the Drawings that is being traded. Once the user defines the Trade Ac and validates the trade, all the facilities and drawings under the underlying asset mentioned in Trade Ac are defaulted in a chronological manner. The system updates this field and user cannot input values manually. |
| Nature | Specifies the account’s nature or product to which the selected Loan Ac belongs. For example, Term Facility Libor Drawing Once the user defines Loan Ac , the system updates this field automatically and user input is restricted. |
| Ccy | Specifies the currency of the account. This is a read-only field and once the user defines Loan Ac , the system updates this field automatically. |
| Tot Trade Amt | Specifies the total commitment amount being traded. Based on the value in Share Percent , the system calculates the pro-rated value for the underlying Loan Accounts and auto-populates this field. |
| Drawn | Drawn amount is shown for every Loan Ac , If Drawn is shown for a facility, it specifies the trading portion of utilized commitment in the facility by the underlying drawings. If Drawn is shown for a Drawing, it represents the principal amount of the drawing. This is an auto-populated read-only field. If the trade is a buy trade and New Buyer is checked, then the system allows the manual input |
| Undrawn | Specifies the trading portion of unutilized commitment in the facility or the drawing. This is an auto-populated read-only field. If the trade is a buy trade and New Buyer is checked, then the system allows the manual input. |

**Capturing Trade Transaction**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Price | Defaulted from LOAN.TRADE application |
| Txn Date | Specifies the date on which the system updates the LOAN.TRADE.BALANCES application. If there is any amendment of trade details, the system creates a new record with the date of amendment as Txn Date |
| Loan Ac | Defaulted from LOAN.TRADE application |
| Name | Defaulted from LOAN.TRADE application |
| Nature | Defaulted from LOAN.TRADE application |
| Ccy | Defaulted from LOAN.TRADE application |
| FX Rate | Specifies the rate applied on Drawings if facility currency is different from Drawings. A facility and its underlying drawings can be in different currencies. System uses ‘FX rate’ as the exchange rate to convert all the drawings in the same currency which is the facility’s currency as well |
| Tot Trade Amt | Defaulted from LOAN.TRADE application |
| Drawn | Defaulted from LOAN.TRADE application |
| Undrawn | Defaulted from LOAN.TRADE application |
| Premium/Discount | Specifies the value of the loan for the drawn amount at the given price. The system updates this field when the Transaction Type is BUY or SELL. The system calculates the premium or discount only after the trade is ‘Executed’ using EXECUTE-TRADE activity |
| Netback | Netback is the compensation given by the counterparty on the undrawn amount of the loan being traded when the loan is bought or sold at discount or premium. The system performs the following: Calculates the value of this field based on the undrawn portion of the Facility or drawings. Calculates the netback amount and auto-populates this field, only when it is agreed in the trade agreement and the Allow Netback field is checked. Updates this field when the Transaction Type is BUY or SELL. Calculates netback only after the trade is ‘Executed’ using EXECUTE-TRADE activity |
| BoCR | The system calculates and updates the value of this field at the Facility level, Only when there is permanent reduction of commitment or prepayment of principal by the borrowed from trade date to settlement date (inclusive of both). The user must check the Allow BoCR field. When the Transaction Type is BUY or SELL. Only after the trade is ‘Executed’ using EXECUTE-TRADE activity. This is an auto-populated read-only field |
| Net Settlement | Specifies the net settlement amount related to the Facility or drawings. The system calculates the net settlement amount and updates this field, When the Transaction Type is BUY or SELL. Only after the trade is ‘Executed’ using EXECUTE-TRADE activity. This is an auto-populated read-only field |

**Loan Trade Products**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Short Desc | Specifies the short description of the trade type |
| Full Desc | Specifies the full description of the trade type. |

**Loan Trade Products**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Type Of trade | Specifies the type of trade being performed. The types available are: Par – For capturing a par trade Distressed – For capturing a distressed trade |
| Governing Law | Specifies the trade’s governing body. The allowed options are: LMA – Loan Market (EMEA) LSTA – Loan Market (America) APMLA - Loan Market (Asia and Pacific) Others – Loan Market (Others) |
| Trade Currency (allowed) | Specifies the list of currencies in which the trade is allowed. Helps banks to control the list of currencies in which loans can be traded. When a currency is added or removed and the product is published, then all the new trades follow the updated setup. If currency is not defined in allowed or restricted currency, it means that trade is allowed in all the currencies. The values in the Allowed Ccy and Restricted Ccy fields are mutually exclusive where either value can be defined. |
| Trade Currency (restricted) | Specifies the list of currencies in which the trade cannot be performed. Helps banks to control the list of currencies in which loans can be traded. When a currency is added or removed and the product is published, then all the new trades follow the updated setup. The values in the Allowed ccy and Restricted Ccy fields are mutually exclusive, that is, if users define any value in one field, they cannot define any value in another field. |
| Closure Days | Specifies the number of days after which the trade records in CANCELLED or SETTLED status are moved to history for the product. |
| Category | Specifies the category code under which the profit and loss entries are raised for the product. The value must be in the range of 35001-35010 and a valid record in the CATEGORY application. |

**Loan Trade Products**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Settlement Currency | Specifies the trade currency for which the default Settlement Days is specified while creating the product |
| Settlement Days | Specifies the default Settlement Days for a trade. When a trade is captured using this product, the system uses this value to calculate and default the expected settlement date for a trade, that is, the value 10W indicates the settlement date as T+10 working days where T is the trade date. This field is a mandatory when the Settlement Currency is specified. |
| Bus Day Centers | Specifies the region wise holiday calendars which determines the expected settlement date based on the Settlement Days defined. This field can be multivalued to define multiple calendars for a single trade currency. This field is a mandatory field when Settlement Days is specified in working days. |

**Loan Trade Products**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Inc Premium Sale | Specifies the PL category to which the income of the premium sale is to be credited. If the value is set as amort, this field specifies the charge property under which the amount is parked. The value must be a valid ID in LOAN.TRADE.CHARGE.CONDITIONS with type as ‘Receive’. |
| Inc Discounted Purchase | Specifies the PL category to which the income of discounted purchase to be credited. If the value is set as amort, this field specifies the charge property under which the income to be posted. The value must be a valid ID in LOAN.TRADE.CHARGE.CONDITIONS with type as ‘Receive’. |
| Exp Premium Purchase | Specifies the PL category from which the expense of the premium purchase to be debited. If the value is set as amort, specifies the charge property under which the amount is parked. The value must be a valid ID in LOAN.TRADE.CHARGE.CONDITIONS with type as ‘Pay’. |
| Exp Discounted Sale | Specifies the PL category to which expense of the premium sale to be debited. If the value is set as amort, this field specifies the charge property under which the amount is parked. The value must be a valid ID in LOAN.TRADE.CHARGE.CONDITIONS with type as ‘Pay’. |
| Rule Id | Specifies the rule for accounting entries generated after the settlement of a trade. The value must be a valid record in AC.ALLOCATION.RULE . |

**Loan Trade Products**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Effective Date | Specifies the date from which the current product is available in the trade product catalogue to capture a trade. This field is defaulted automatically to the system date when the product is published. |
| Expiry Date | Specifies the date from when this product ceases to exist or suspended. New trades cannot be initiated under the product after this date. After expiry, the product is not available in the catalogue. Users can input current and future dates. Once expired, the product cannot be modified or amended. |
| Action | Users can publish the product using the option Publish in this field. Transact validates whether all the mandatory input fields are defined when the user publishes the product. Once the product is published, it is listed in LOAN.TRADE.PRODUCT.CATALOG . |

**Managing Trade**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Trade Amount | Specifies the total trade amount that is to be traded. During amendment, it can be increased or decreased. |
| Price | Specifies the trade price in percentage. If the price is not defined while capturing the trade, it can be defined later using Amend Commitment Trade activity. Once the price is defined, it cannot be changed. |
| Settlement Option | Settlement Option (Net/Gross) can be amended during the Amend Commitment activity . |
| Allow Netback | Specifies Allow Netback (Yes/No). It can be checked or unchecked during the Amend Commitment activity. |
| Allow BoCR | Specifies if the BoCR needs to be calculated. It can be checked or unchecked during the Amend Commitment activity. |
| Trade Ac | Specifies the Facility or the Drawings that is being traded. It can be amended during the Amend Commitment activity if Exp Settlement Date is not defined yet. It becomes a no-change field if expected settlement date is already defined. |
| Commitment | Specifies the amount being traded under a facility or drawing that is provided in the trade account. Commitment can be increased or decreased during Amend Commitment. The sum of all the Trade Commitment cannot exceed Trade Amount . |

**Managing Trade**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Buyer | Indicates the buyer to whom the trade is to sub-allocated. |
| Trade Ac Ref | Indicates the loan which is sub-allocated. The value provided must be one of the loans which are attached to the parent trade in Trade Ac . All loans mentioned in the Trade Ac field must be sub-allocated. |
| Buyer Share | Specifies the commitment amount which is to be sub-allocated to each buyer for each loan. The sum of all the values defined in the Buyer Share field must be equal to the total value defined in the Commitment field defined at the parent trade. |
| Linked Trade | Specifies the child trade IDs which are automatically created by the system. |

**Misc**

| Parameters | Description |
|---|---|
| LOAN.TRADE.PRODUCT | This parameter table is for creating loan trade products that can be used to capture a new trade after it is published. Separate products can be created according to the governing law and type of trade (par or distressed). Allowed and Restricted currencies for capturing the trade can also be defined here. |
| LOAN.TRADE.PRODUCT.CATALOG | Once a trade product is published, it is moved to the trade product catalogue where it can be used to capture a new trade. Changes done in existing trade products will be reflected in Trade Product catalog only after it is published. |
| EB.LOOKUP | The governing bodies for available in Loan Trade Product are defined in this application. The options available are: LMA - Loan Market (EMEA) LSTA - Loan Market (Americas) APMLA - Loan Market (Asia & Pacific) Others - Loan Market (Others) |
| LOAN.TRADE.CHARGE.CONDITIONS | It is used for creating charge conditions, which can be attached to a trade. Once the charge is created, it is added to a product and captured in a trade. It is also used for configuring the income or expenses arising out of Premium/Discount, Netback and BoCR . |

|---|---|
| Loan Market (Asia & Pacific) | APLMA - PAR APLMA – DISTRESSED |

**Trade Charges**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| @ID | Indicates the name of the charge that is the primary key for LOAN.TRADE.CHARGE.CONDITIONS application. Once defined and authorized, it cannot be amended. |
| Short Desc | Specifies a description of the charge type. It is a mandatory field. |
| Full Desc | Specifies the detailed description of the charge type. It is a mandatory field. |
| Currency | Allows the user to decide the currency in which the charge is posted to the profit and loss account. The available options are: Transaction Currency - If selected, the system posts a charge to the Profit and Loss under accounts in ‘Transaction Currency’. Local Currency - If selected, the system converts the charge to ‘Local currency’ (If the transaction is not in local currency) and posts to Profit and Loss under accounts in ‘Local Currency’. It is a mandatory field. |
| PL Category | Specifies the Profit and Loss Category accounts to which the charge should be posted. This is a mandatory field when the user sets the Amortize field as No. When the user sets the Amortize field as Yes, then this field is not allowed for input. The Pl Category selected here should be a valid record in CATEGORY table. |
| Debit Txn Code | Defines the Transaction code to be used on the debit accounting entry generated by the LOAN.TRADE application when a trade is settled. This is a mandatory field when the system sets the Amortize field as No. When the system sets Amortize as Yes, then this field is not allowed for input . The Debit Txn code should be a valid record in TRANSACTION table. |
| Credit Txn Code | Defines the transaction code to be used on the credit entry generated by the LOAN.TRADE application when a trade is settled. This is a mandatory field when the system sets the Amortize field No. When the system sets Amortize is set as Yes, then this field is not allowed for input . The Credit Txn code should be a valid record in TRANSACTION table. |
| Pay or Receive | Specifies if the charge is either payable or receivable. The system debits the PL category account with a payable charge and credits the PL category account with a receivable charge. This is a mandatory, no change field and the options are mutually exclusive.For example, both the buyer and seller should pay the transfer fee to the agent bank whenever a new trade is initiated, and either the buyer or seller should receive the amendment fee whenever the other party initiates an amendment to the trade. |
| Flat Amount | Specifies the amount of charge if the charge type is Flat. Either Flat Amount or Percentage is mandatory. Both are mutually exclusive. |
| Percentage | Specifies the percentage of charge if the charge type is PERCENTAGE. |
| Calc Source | Specifies the source on which the charge is to be calculated if the charge type is Percentage. System defaults the Trade Amount as Calc Source when percentage is defined. It is a mandatory field if Percentage is set. |
| Amortize | Specifies whether a charge is to be amortized or not. If the user sets this field as Yes, then the system does not post the charge to the Profit and loss account under the PL category account directly and amortizes the charge over a time under a specific account. If the user sets this field to No, then the system posts the charge to the Profit and Loss account under the PL category specified directly. By default, the option is selected as ‘No’ and it is a no change field. |
| Amort Property | If the user sets the Amortize field as Yes, then it is mandatory to define Amort Property . The property defined here should be a valid non-customer charge property in the underlying arrangement of the trade in Arrangement Architecture (AA). The system mentions the underlying arrangement for a trade in the Credit Agreement Details tab in the Reference field. If the Amortization is for Income, then the Charge ‘Property type’ must be Debit. If the amortization is for Expenses, then the charge property should be Credit. It is a no change field. |

**Trade Charges**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Charge Name | Specifies the name of the charge. This must be a valid @ID defined in LOAN.TRADE.CHARGE.CONDITIONS . Once a charge condition is attached to a loan trade product, the system defaults this field automatically with the charge name when the relevant activity is captured under that product. Users can remove or change the charge name before a trade is authorized. Any time before settlement, users can multi-value this field and add a charge by selecting the charge condition from the drop down. When the system defaults or adds a charge condition, all the relevant details of the charge defined in LOAN.TRADE.CHARGE.CONDITIONS are also defaulted in the LOAN.TRADE application. |
| Currency | Specifies the currency in which the fee is to be paid or received. By default, the currency is the local currency defaulted from the COMPANY table and the user can modify it. The currency specified here should an allowed currency in the LOAN.TRADE.PRODUCT application. This is a mandatory field when Charge Name is entered. |
| Type | Specifies the charge type as percentage or flat. The system defaults this field from LOAN.TRADE.CHARGE.CONDITIONS . The user cannot modify this field as this is a no input field. |
| Amort | Specifies whether the charge is to be amortized or not. The system defaults the value from LOAN.TRADE.CHARGE.CONDITIONS . The user cannot modify the value. If the user sets this field as Yes, then Amort Property defined in LOAN.TRADE.CHARGE.CONDITIONS should be a valid non-customer Charge property in the underlying Facility or Deal in the Arrangement Architecture(AA). The reference for the Facility or Deal is defined in the Reference field under the Credit Agreement Details tab in the LOAN.TRADE application. If the Amortization is for Income, then the Charge Property type’ must be Debit. If the amortization is for Expenses, then the charge property must be Credit. |
| Amort AC | Specifies under which account this charge is to be amortized. The allowed accounts are any account in the credit structure defined in Trade Details tab in the LOAN.TRADE application. |
| Percentage | If the charge type is Percentage , this field specifies the percentage based on which the charge is calculated. The system defaults the percentage from LOAN.TRADE.CHARGE.CONDITIONS and the user can modify it. However, the user cannot modify the system-calculated amount as the system automatically calculates this amount. |
| Charge Amt | Specifies the actual charge amount. If the charge type is Percentage, then this field is the calculated amount, and user cannot modify. If the charge type is Flat, then the user can modify this field. The system defaults the Charge amount from the LOAN.TRADE.CHARGE.CONDITIONS application and user can modify the same. |
| Bearer | Specifies the bank that bears the charge. The available options are: Buyer - If selected, the system defaults Sellers Share to zero and Buyers Share with the charge amount. Seller - If selected, the system defaults Buyers Share to zero and Sellers Share with the charge amount. Split - If selected, a value greater than zero is needs to be entered in both the Buyers Share and Sellers Share and the sum should be equal to the charge amount. |
| Sellers Share | Specifies the share of the selling bank in the total charge. Input is allowed only when the user selects the bearer as Split. |
| Buyers Share | Specifies the share of the buying bank in the total charge. Input is allowed only when the user selects the bearer as Split. |
| Receiver | Specifies the bank that receives the charge. The available options are Buyer, Seller and Agent. If the user sets Bearer as seller, then the Receiver can be either buyer or agent. If Bearer is buyer, Receiver can be seller or agent. If Bearer is split, Receiver can only be agent. |
| Waiver | Specifies that the charge is waived or not. The default value is No. If the user sets this field as Yes, then the system does not raise any accounting entries during settlement. The user can amend this field. |
| Paid In Adv | Specifies any fee paid or received in advance. By default, the value is No. If the user sets this field as Yes, it indicates that the charge is received or paid in advance. Hence during settlement, the accounting entry raised adjusts the internal account and ignores the intended recipient. The user can amend this field. |
